_readme: Aero's Base addresses for the new PandaVault (scripts/deploy-aero-vault.js). Aero publishes them on launch day (2026-10-22); until every field below is filled the script refuses to run. Fill each field with the address Aero publishes for Base (chain 8453), copied from Aero's official deployment-addresses file or docs, never from a chat or a block explorer comment. The '_' line under each field says what it is.
_clFactory: Aero's Slipstream CL pool factory (CLFactory). Must be the factory of the pool, the position manager and the swap router below.
_gaugeFactory: Aero's CL gauge factory (CLGaugeFactory). The gauge's gaugeFactory(); holds the early-unstake penalty config (effectivePenaltyConfig).
_wethUsdcPool: Aero's WETH/USDC CL pool the vault will use (WETH 0x4200...0006, USDC 0x8335...2913). Tick spacing 50 expected; if Aero's pool uses another spacing the script re-expresses the guard rails.
_wethUsdcGauge: The Aero gauge of that pool (pool.gauge()).
_positionManager: Aero's NonfungiblePositionManager (the NFT the gauge accepts: gauge.nft()).
_swapRouter: Aero's Slipstream SwapRouter (exactInput with token, int24 tickSpacing, token paths).
_leafVoter: Aero's LeafVoter on Base (gauge.voter()); it settles and mints the gauge's emissions.
_aero: The NEW AERO token Aero's gauges pay (Aero 'Token', minted by its Minter). Not the old Aerodrome AERO 0x9401...8631.
_aeroUsdcPool: Aero's AERO/USDC CL pool (new AERO). Checked to exist; the compound route uses it only with ROUTE=usdc.
_aeroWethPool: Aero's AERO/WETH CL pool (new AERO). The default compound route: AERO -> WETH in one hop, as the live vault does.
